statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let minor := fun n : ℕ => (intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; let bad := fun n : ℕ => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n; (∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0<c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → c*(n:ℝ) ≤ (major n).re) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, N ≤ X → (Finset.sum ((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter Even) (fun n => (max 0 (-minor n))^2)) ≤ C * (X:ℝ) ^ (18/7 + e)) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, N ≤ X → ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Icc X (2*X))).card : ℝ) ≤ C * (X:ℝ) ^ (4/7 + e))

plain_statement.zh: 从主弧线性下界和次弧负部二阶矩推出二进区间例外计数。
plain_statement.en: Derive the dyadic exceptional-set count from a positive major-arc floor and negative minor-arc energy.

brief.zh: 每个例外的全积分为零，因此负贡献至少为 cX。平方计数将指数 18/7+ε 降到 4/7+ε。
brief.en: Each exception has zero total integral, so its negative minor contribution is at least cX. Dividing the squared budget by c²X² uses the energy exponent 18/7 + ε.
